claims.statement: Poland had 1,636,673 grid-connected renewable micro-installations at the end of 2025, 99.9% of which were photovoltaic, creating a large installed base rather than only a new-sales market.
IEA PVPS operations-and-maintenance guidance treats performance indicators, monitoring, forecasting, analysis, maintenance services, and advanced inspections as core O&M functions.
Hypothesis: small O&M operators will contribute labeled repair outcomes in exchange for faster diagnosis and cross-fleet benchmarks if tenant isolation and contractual data rights are explicit.

contrary_evidence: Large inverter vendors already provide monitoring portals and may improve their own fault recommendations.
Many residential faults may be infrequent or uneconomic for owners to repair, limiting per-site value.

economics.acquisition_route: Hypothesis: land O&M portfolios through a free alert-history import and charge after the first 30 days of recovered-production evidence.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 10000 monitored sites in year 2, 75000 in year 4, and 250000 in year 6 at 4 PLN/site/month yields 12M PLN ARR. At a 4-6x ARR value and 55-70% founder ownership, the equity path clears 5M PLN well before the terminal milestone if churn and data rights hold.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 15-20 hours/week for two vendor connectors and one fleet pilot, then support can be partially delegated.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 82-90% at scale after cloud telemetry, alert delivery, and support; early connector maintenance will depress margin.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 4-7 months at 5000 PLN acquisition cost for a 500-site operator paying 2500-4000 PLN monthly.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 3-8 PLN per monitored site per month with a 499 PLN monthly floor and premium dispatch analytics.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Hypothesis: high repeat from continuous monitoring, accumulated asset history, and technician workflow integration; target net revenue retention above 105% through site growth.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Normalized cross-vendor telemetry joined to technician-confirmed cause, repair action, part, and recovery outcome
fingerprint.customer: Regional PV installers and O&M firms managing 100-5000 small systems
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: O&M portfolio migration tool, inverter/wholesaler integrations, and an initial reference implementation through the family business
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Vendor-neutral anomaly triage and repair-learning SaaS with technician feedback loops
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: O&M firm pays per monitored site or fleet subscription when the system enters active monitoring
fingerprint.problem_trigger: An inverter alert, underproduction anomaly, or technician dispatch decision

founder_fit: Direct fit with anomaly detection, predictive modeling, and data pipelines.
Parents' installer base can seed real but permissioned fault workflows and labels.
Remote, asynchronous product is compatible with low-social-energy preferences.
Can begin with CSV/email ingestion before expensive integrations.
risks: Incorrect repair suggestions could cause safety incidents or equipment damage; outputs need qualified-technician review.
A few dominant manufacturers could close APIs or replicate the product.

structure.control_point: cross-vendor fault-to-repair outcome graph embedded in technician triage
structure.critical_dependency: durable telemetry access and consistent technician outcome labeling

thesis: A telemetry-normalization and repair-learning layer for regional photovoltaic maintenance firms. It maps inverter alerts and production anomalies to technician-confirmed causes, actions, parts, and time-to-recovery, so every resolved fault improves triage recommendations across the network.
title: PV FaultGraph for Regional O&M Firms
uncertainties: API availability and contractual reuse rights vary by inverter vendor.
The density of labeled faults required to outperform vendor manuals is unknown.
The 70000 PLN capital estimate and all pricing, adoption, payback, and valuation figures below are planning hypotheses.
